title: 'No ambulances, no coordination': Family alleges lapses after Air India turbulence scare
content: Palak Raniwala, daughter of the passenger injured on the Air India flight AI2379 operating from Phuket to Delhi after it faced sudden loss of altitude during cruise, recounted the harrowing experience, saying that the turbulence was so severe that it caused passengers, including her father, to touch the ceiling of the aircraft.

title: Why US cities are deactivating Flock Safety cameras and canceling contracts
content: Cities across America are deactivating Flock's automated license plate reader cameras. Residents are damaging these devices amid widespread privacy concerns and data collection fears. Reports of law enforcement misuse have further fueled opposition to the surveillance technology. Flock maintains its cameras balance public safety and individual privacy rights. The company has implemented new audit processes to monitor technology usage.

title: 'Don't use students for politics': BJP attacks Rahul over Jantar Mantar protest claims
content: The Bharatiya Janata Party has rejected Rahul Gandhi's allegations of police excesses.  BJP spokesperson Sambit Patra stated no bullets were fired during the protest.  He accused Gandhi of spreading a false narrative and using students politically.  Patra also questioned Gandhi's selective focus on certain student groups.  The party maintained that ministers attend Parliament when their departments are discussed.

title: Who is Tewolde Gebremariam? All you need to know about Air India’s new CEO
content: Tewolde Gebremariam takes over from Campbell Wilson, the New Zealander and former Singapore Airlines executive who was appointed in 2022 to lead Air India's transformation. Air India had earlier disclosed that Wilson had informed Chairman N Chandrasekaran in 2024 of his intention to step down during 2026.

title: OpenAI's Greg Brockman gives millions to save eagles Jackie and Shadow's home
content: Greg Brockman and his wife Anna donated five point five million dollars to save shoreline forest.  This significant contribution helped secure ten million dollars for land conservation efforts.  The land, which is home to rare species, will now be protected from development.  Over twenty-five thousand small donors also contributed to the successful fundraising campaign.  Meanwhile, the eagle matriarch Jackie faces an uncertain health prognosis.

title: After Pakistan boxer, Uganda athletes go ‘missing’ in Glasgow after CWG
content: Scottish police are probing reports of athletes from Pakistan and Uganda going missing after the 2026 Commonwealth Games in Glasgow. Four Ugandan boxers reportedly disappeared, with one seeking asylum, while Pakistani boxer Qudratullah was also reported missing. Pakistan finished with just one medal, a bronze for Fatima Zahra, marking its poorest Commonwealth Games campaign in decades.

title: Meet Seungah Chung, who used 200 ants to reveal how they navigate
content: A bright young student embarked on a fascinating ant navigation experiment fueled by her natural curiosity. Through her meticulous research, she uncovered that ants primarily depend on visual markers for navigation. This groundbreaking project garnered her acclaim at a well-regarded science competition, showcasing the potential of such findings to inspire the development of innovative robots and autonomous systems.

title: California to close westbound Zampa Bridge for 53 hours
content: Important notice for travelers: Westbound access on the Al Zampa Memorial Bridge will be entirely shut down for 53 hours, commencing on Friday, August 21, and concluding on Monday, August 24, to facilitate necessary repairs. Motorists are urged to anticipate heavy delays and to follow detour signs. Please be advised that foot and bicycle traffic will also be halted during this repair window. Prepare your travel plans accordingly.

title: Priscilla Chan founded a school in 2016; 10 yrs later, it closed after $125m funding
content: The Primary School, a tuition-free institution, will close in June after a decade of operation. This school provided education, healthcare, and family support to low-income children. The Chan Zuckerberg Initiative will not continue funding beyond the upcoming academic year. Academic results remained below state averages, prompting the board's decision. The initiative pledged fifty million dollars to aid the transition for affected students.

title: Nearly 2,000 RSS volunteers assist over 40,000 flood-affected families in Assam
content: Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh volunteers aided over forty thousand families in Assam's flood-hit regions. They provided rescue, food, and essential supplies to affected villagers in three districts. Medical camps were organized by the organization in collaboration with the National Medicos Organization. Volunteers also assisted with post-flood rehabilitation, including cleaning and agricultural support. These efforts focused on helping communities recover after the recent devastating floods.

title: Brock Lesnar retires: WWE legend shares official statement and future plans
content: Brock Lesnar has hung up his wrestling boots after a climactic showdown at SummerSlam 2026, where he was defeated by Oba Femi in the main event. In a reflective interview afterward, he revealed his intention to focus on family life and pursue recreational hunting. Lesnar showed immense appreciation for his fans, acknowledging their integral role in his journey through the wrestling world.

title: Delhi cop loses Rs 6 lakh in gaming, scripts ATM thefts to recover losses
content: After incurring heavy losses in online gaming, a Delhi Police constable turned to ATM theft as a solution. He gathered a team and taught them criminal tactics through internet videos. Their efforts led to the theft of more than twelve lakh rupees from two ATMs in Faridabad. However, the constable was left empty-handed when his gang refused to share the loot.

title: 'When Dhoni stepped away, Kohli-Shastri toughened Indian cricket': Rahane
content: Ajinkya Rahane believes Virat Kohli and Ravi Shastri toughened Indian cricket.  They instilled a fearless and aggressive approach, especially in overseas matches.  India achieved significant success under their leadership during this period.  Rahane expressed concern about the current Test cricket mentality and resilience.  He noted a decline in the patience required for difficult match phases.

title: Sambhal violence 2024: Probe panel claims unrest 'pre-planned', links SP MP, MLA
content: Last year, three-member panel had met the CM and submitted its report concerning the violence that erupted near the Shahi Jama Masjid on November 24 in 2024 during an ASI-monitored survey of the mosque. The unrest resulted in four fatalities and injuries to several others. In the document, a sharp demographic shift is observed.

title: Morgan Freeman's quote on taking a leap of faith to chase your dreams
content: Morgan Freeman's career is defined by dignity and wisdom.  His quote emphasizes risking everything for unseen dreams.  Freeman aspired to be a fighter pilot in his youth.  He later pursued acting, debuting on Broadway in 1967.  His extensive filmography includes numerous acclaimed performances.

title: Food for thought: Is Delhi's midday meal nutritious enough?
content: A dead lizard in a Delhi school lunch has renewed scrutiny of the midday meal program.  Concerns include hygiene, serving portions, and menu variety for students.  The PM Poshan scheme outlines nutritional entitlements for primary and upper primary students.  Budget limitations influence menu planning, affecting the inclusion of items like eggs.  Teachers and parents debate whether the promised nutrition reaches every child's plate.

title: Lucknow-Kanpur Expressway damage: Toll collection suspended
content: The National Highways Authority of India has proposed declaring PNC Infratech a non-performer entity. Toll collection on the Lucknow-Kanpur Expressway has been suspended until repairs are completed. Action has also been initiated against sitting and former project directors for alleged negligence. An IIT Kharagpur team will investigate the cause of the road slippage. The concessionaire will bear the cost of rectifying the damaged stretch.

title: Watch: Indian cargo ship engulfed in flames & smoke after projectile strike off Yemen
content: An Indian-flagged cargo vessel was struck by a projectile in Yemeni waters. The ship caught fire and sank off Yemen’s western coast near Hodeidah. All fourteen crew members, including thirteen Indians, were rescued by the Yemeni Coast Guard. The National Resistance Forces blamed Houthi rebels for the unprovoked attack. India's Ministry of External Affairs condemned the incident and called for unimpeded navigation.

title: Trump's immigration crackdown hits US military families; over 50 spouses, parents detained
content: Dozens of parents and spouses of US service members face detention and deportation. This marks a significant shift from prior bipartisan immigration policies for military families. Many are detained during routine immigration status adjustment appointments. The Department of Homeland Security states military service does not exempt violations of immigration laws. These detentions negatively impact military readiness and family stability.

title: North Korea deploys missile unit, sends fresh ballistic arsenal to Russia: Ukraine
content: Ukraine has accused North Korea of providing Russia with new ballistic missiles along with personnel, involving around ninety North Koreans and multiple missile launchers. Reports indicate that a North Korean missile was used by Russia in a recent attack. This development signals a heightened level of military collaboration between Moscow and Pyongyang, following their treaty signed in June 2024.

title: Penguins linked to former Oilers goalie Connor Ingram in NHL free agency
content: Connor Ingram has surpisingly still been a free agent after his contract expired with the Edmonton Oilers. Ahead of the new season, Pittsburgh Penguins have been linked to him.

title: BJP lost Bankipur, Datia bypolls deliberately to mislead on EVMs: Akhilesh
content: Samajwadi Party leader Akhilesh Yadav has leveled accusations against the BJP, suggesting they deliberately lost the recent bypolls to distort public opinion on election integrity. He pointed out that the BJP’s departure from its typical campaign strategies was aimed at undermining opposition claims about EVMs. Yadav also promised that upcoming vacancies within the UP government would be filled by loyal party supporters.

title: 'Stalker abducted her once': Faridabad teacher lured to gate before her murder
content: A teacher was fatally stabbed by a man who had stalked her for two years.  He had previously abducted her and assaulted her husband, ignoring family assurances.  The victim had warned him of a police complaint if harassment continued.  The accused tricked her to the school gate using her husband's nickname.  Security lapses at the school allowed the masked assailant to enter the campus.

title: Watch: Video captures panic on Air India Phuket-Delhi flight
content: An Air India flight from Phuket to Delhi experienced severe turbulence on Tuesday.  Overhead bins were damaged and debris was scattered across the aisle.  Several passengers and crew members sustained injuries during the turbulent event.  The aircraft briefly lost altitude before landing safely in Delhi.  The Directorate General of Civil Aviation has initiated an investigation into the incident.

title: 'Grave security threat': CJP's Saurav Das alleges media 'breaking into' his house
content: The Cockroach Janta Party began as a satirical online response to a statement by Chief Justice of India Surya Kant but later developed into a broader youth-led campaign. The movement has focused on issues including exam security, administrative reforms and employment-related concerns. Das became one of CJP's most visible representatives due to his background in journalism and his ability to present arguments through data, documents and legal references.

title: Scientists link rising CO₂ to decline of the world's largest bees
content: Increasing atmospheric carbon dioxide levels pose a new threat to global pollinators.  Larger bee species are becoming less abundant and genetically diverse.  This shift favors smaller-bodied pollinators, impacting crucial pollination services.  Nutritional changes in plants make it harder for large bees to meet energy demands.  Protecting these vital pollinators requires addressing rising carbon dioxide emissions.

title: Falcons could target veteran pass rushers after Jalon Walker's ACL scare
content: Atlanta's Jalon Walker faces a potential season-ending leg injury from training camp. This paves the way for seasoned edge rushers looking for a team. Joey Bosa, released by the Buffalo Bills, stands out as a prime candidate. Alongside him, Von Miller, formerly of the Washington Commanders, is also available. Each player presents a great opportunity to strengthen the Falcons.

title: As gold, stock markets lose lustre - why your humble fixed deposit is forever
content: Experts say that instead of timing the interest rate cycle, fixed deposits should be opted for based on goals and cash flow. But, if you are looking at fresh investments in FDs, higher interest rates may be a good lure. Is it the right time to invest in FDs? We ask experts:

title: Kanwar Yatra in burqa: SDM court summons Tamanna Malik, husband
content: An SDM court issued notices to Tamanna Malik and her husband Aman Tyagi.  This action followed Malik's announcement to undertake the Kanwar Yatra while wearing a burqa.  Police cited apprehension of a potential breach of peace and law-and-order concerns.  The couple was bound down on personal bonds as a preventive measure.  They must appear before the court to provide an explanation for their decision.

title: In MP, A-certified ‘Dhurandhar’ screened at govt school
content: A video shows an adult film screened for students at a school.  The incident occurred on July thirty-first in Madhya Pradesh's Maihar district.  Villagers lodged a complaint seeking strict action against responsible individuals.  District education officer confirmed an investigation will be conducted soon.  Disciplinary action will follow the inquiry report's findings.

title: 'No trust in judiciary, EC': Dipke on political plans; calls for mass movement
content: Abhijeet Dipke, CJP founder, ruled out converting his organization into a political party. He stated public trust in democratic institutions has significantly eroded. Dipke emphasized the urgent need for a nationwide people's movement and public pressure. This movement aims to restore accountability and neutrality in key institutions. The CJP will continue functioning as a pressure group focusing on various national issues.

title: Nearly half of India's workforce wants a new job. Here's why
content: Google leads India's most attractive employer brands, with Tata Group and Amazon following closely.  Nearly half of India's workforce plans job changes within the next six months.  Work-life balance and career progression are key factors influencing employee preferences.  Employers must adapt to evolving talent expectations beyond conventional benefits.  Organisations offering growth and flexibility will attract and retain top talent effectively.

title: Novig trolls Kenny Pickett after Panthers start him over Bryce Young
content: With Kenny Pickett stepping up as the Carolina Panthers’ new starting quarterback, he navigates the storm of social media criticism regarding his hand size. Just before the Hall of Fame game, he prepares to showcase his skills while previous starter Bryce Young watches on. A strong performance could solidify Pickett’s position as the team’s long-term solution at quarterback.

title: 'Blast, blast' budget turned out 'waste, waste': Stalin's 'reel CM' swipe at Vijay
content: Tamil Nadu's opposition leader M.K. Stalin criticized the TVK government's budget as a waste. He stated the budget repackaged old schemes and lacked new vision. The finance minister presented a budget aiming for a $1.5 trillion economy by 2031. Opposition parties also pointed out unfulfilled election promises and debt concerns. The budget included allocations for schools, higher education, and welfare initiatives.

title: 'Why no system to remove defamatory posts?' Bombay HC on Gadkari deepfake case
content: The Bombay High Court ordered social media intermediaries to remove vile and abusive online content.  These posts falsely linked Union Minister Nitin Gadkari to the ethanol-blended petrol controversy.  The court granted urgent interim relief to the minister against several platforms.  Gadkari sought damages for fabricated and defamatory digital content, including deepfake videos.  The court also directed intermediaries to furnish basic customer information of content creators.

title: Aamir Khan at Rawat funeral: Veteran ‘Ghajini’ actor dies at 74; colleagues pay tribute
content: Veteran actor Pradeep Rawat was bid a final farewell in Mumbai, with Aamir Khan, Ashoke Pandit and other film personalities attending his last rites. Rawat, who died at 74 after battling blood cancer, was remembered for iconic roles in Ghajini, Lagaan and Mahabharat during his four-decade-long career.

title: Srisailam water to quench thirst of Rayalaseema
content: Prioritising drinking water security amid El Niño concerns, the government decides to make use of the Krishna waters from within Andhra Pradesh’s 63% share, says Water Resources Minister Nimmala Ramanaidu

content: Amid mounting discontent within the Karnataka Congress over the Cabinet expansion, an audio recording of a purported conversation between two senior Congress leaders has triggered fresh political controversy

content: Modi also instructs the MPs to guard against the misuse of their letterhead and avoid being rude to people over phone

content: Both Houses witnessed repeated disruptions over the alleged Ram Temple donation scam and the Opposition’s demand for a statement from Home Minister Amit Shah on police action against protesters

title: Kerala rains 2026: orange alert for seven districts on August 6
content: IMD issues an orange alert for seven districts — Kasaragod, Kannur, Ernakulam, Idukki, Kottayam, Pathanamthitta, and Alappuzha — on August 6. Remaining seven districts remain under a yellow alert for isolated heavy rain.

title: Padmavathi Ishaq passes away in Australia
content: Born at Chalavara in Palakkad district, Padmavathi was a writer and former history teacher at Government Sanskrit College, Pattambi

title: In-charge Collector directs officials to expedite road safety measures in Annamayya
content: Chairing the District Road Safety Committee meeting, Shiv Narayan Sharma says safety measures have been completed at 108 spots of the total 236 sites identified across the district

title: Karnataka High Court refuses to quash FIR against self-proclaimed Congress leaders in ₹5.3 crore job racket case
content: The High Court of Karnataka has refused to quash a criminal case registered against two self-proclaimed Congress leaders for cheating over ₹5.3 crore promising jobs in various government departments

title: Aquafit initiative to train 14,000 students in swimming in first phase in Kerala
content: Minister for General Education N. Samsudheen inaugurates General Education department’s programme for schoolchildren

title: Seven arrested after tiger poaching incident at NSTR
content: Officials recover seven tiger claws, limb bones, a country made fire arm and an axe from the accused; HANUMAN project team played a key role in the investigation, says Giddalur Project Tiger Division Deputy Director

title: Sambar deer rescued from HNSS Canal in Sri Sathya Sai district
content: Forest official says that the deer was searching for water when it slipped into the canal and its injuries prevented it from reaching the bank

title: T.N. Budget fails to meet expectations of people, say political leaders in Coimbatore
content: Former BJP MLA Vanathi Srinivasan says various schemes launched by the Centre have just been rebranded and announced as new ones; KMDK general secretary E.R. Eswaran says Budget has no mention of the much-awaited Avinashi-Athikadavu project expansion

title: Muthanga land agitation: Geethanandan and other accused approach Kerala High Court
content: The accused reasoned that the Kalpetta court had only found conspiracy charges prima facie, and contended that such a finding did not fulfill the legal requirements of the offence.

title: Rope in AP Markfed to facilitate tobacco procurement, demands YSRCP chief Jagan
content: This will facilitate competition among the bidders and help bring the growers out of distress, reasons Jagan Mohan Reddy, while accusing the State government of failing to ensure support prices for crops

title: Officials launch campaign to minimise El Nino impact on inland fisheries
content: The initiative, which will conclude on August 7, will focus on educating stakeholders on scientific measures to minimise losses due to adverse climatic conditions, says Fisheries Deputy Director

title: UDF facilitating Sangh agenda in universities, says Pinarayi
content: He says UDF government is facilitating the Sangh Parivar’s agenda in Kerala’s higher education sector by remaining silent on the Governor’s interventions in universities and abandoning the resistance mounted by the previous LDF government

title: Amid backlash, Kerala Transport Minister C.P. John apologises for controversial remark about women availing free bus travel scheme
content: Minister says he ‘should have been more cautious’ and that he had only sought to ‘make a political point’ that poverty existed in Kerala

title: Arrest warrant scam: Private firm employee in Bengaluru loses ₹3.2 lakh in cyber fraud
content: A 46-year-old warehouse in-charge employed with a private firm in Bengaluru was allegedly cheated of ₹3.2 lakh by unidentified persons who posed as officials from the National Investigation Agency and threatened him with arrest using a fake warrant

title: AIIMS for Kinalur in Kozhikode: more organisations jump on to the bandwagon
content: Communist Party of India to organise protest demonstration on Thursday; Calicut Chamber of Commerce and Industry says avoiding Kinalur is akin to neglecting Malabar’s developmental aspirations

title: Chargesheet on Nedumangad child murder case not filed due to delay in receiving forensic report: State informs Kerala High Court
content: The one-and-a-half-year-old in Nedumangad had sustained over 90 internal and external injuries. Though the child was brought to hospitals for bone fractures before his death, the systematic trauma was never flagged or reported by treating personnel

title: Rescue hopes adrift as marine ambulance remains out of service in Kerala’s Kozhikode
content: Fishermen reiterate demand for a dedicated sea rescue service as the ₹6-crore vessel awaits repairs more than a year after going out of service

content: Muthanga agitation has returned to the limelight after a court recently acquitted all accused who stood trial, including social activist M. Geethanandan, in the case relating to murder of a police constable. However, it convicted Geethanandan and three others on related charges

content: KUDA chairman Mazhar Alam Khan says the dream project of late Qamar-ul-Islam is taking shape with Home Minister Priyank Kharge’s support and asserted that infrastructure works will begin within a month

content: Air India said Gebremariam is widely recognised as one of the most successful aviation chief executives who headed Ethiopian Airlines Group's multi-billion-dollar expansion.

content: President Donald Trump's administration has detained dozens of parents and spouses of active-duty U.S. troops as it rolls back immigration protections for military families to pursue its mass deportation agenda, an Associated Press investigation found.

content: Ashok Mittal said that official figures indicate a rise in the number of Indians killed abroad. He said the number increased from 29 in 2021 to 86 in 2023, describing the trend as deeply worrying.

content: Bankipur is like the NOIDA of Uttar Pradesh. Its voter list isn't like the rest of Bihar. Which is why one must be careful in declaring Kishor's win a phenomenon - yet. But then, there's the power of the voter...

content: Legendary mountaineer Nirmal Purja, known worldwide as 'Nimsdai', is finally set to return home after his body was recovered from Broad Peak and brought down to Base Camp in a challenging rescue operation led by his friend.

content: In the 230-member Madhya Pradesh Assembly, 228 MLAs were eligible to vote, with 58 votes required to elect one Rajya Sabha member.

content: Jharkhand Chief Electoral Officer (CEO) K Ravi Kumar said the state had 2.64 crore voters before the beginning of the enumeration phase of SIR in the state.

title: Russia's 'Human Safaris' Are Bringing Terror To Ukraine's Frontline Cities
content: Kherson is among the first places where Russian forces began using short-range FPV drones against civilians. Equipped with live-streaming cameras, the aircraft allow operators to observe targets in real time and make decisions moments before impact.

content: Facing heat from far-right coalition partners ahead of upcoming elections, Benjamin Netanyahu has pushed back on a US Gaza draft plan - though experts say Israel has little room to reject its key ally.

content: T V Somanathan, a 1987-batch Indian Administrative Service (IAS) officer of the Tamil Nadu cadre, was appointed to the post for two years in August 2024.
